verdict.rationale: Cake documents a 'flexible vesting engine' that automates cliffs, schedules, milestones and pauses, and it supports vesting on founder shares at issuance. Vesting is also tracked automatically: the dashboard shows upcoming vesting events and who vests next, vesting data can be queried through MCP, and unvested shares can be returned through buy-backs. Acceleration on exit, an explicit part of the story, is never mentioned, and all evidence is thin vendor marketing or help-centre copy. Missing for 10: single/double-trigger acceleration on exit, detailed docs on custom schedule configuration and vested/unvested reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
